name: DC Hub - Data Center Intelligence
description: Real-time data center intelligence: 12,500+ facilities, 126,000 substations, live grid demand for all 7 US ISOs (PJM, MISO, ERCOT, CAISO, NYISO, SPP, ISONE), transmission lines, fiber routes, gas pipelines, NEPA filings, M&A pipeline, and AI infrastructure deals. The only MCP server combining facility, infrastructure, and live grid data into one queryable interface for AI agents doing site selection, energy analysis, or market research.

tools.name: search_facilities
tools.description: Search 12,500+ global data center facilities by location, capacity, operator, market, fiber connectivity, or status. Try: search_facilities operator=Equinix country=US

tools.name: get_facility
tools.description: Get detailed info on a specific facility: capacity (MW), power topology, connectivity providers, operator, status, addresses. Try: get_facility id=1234

tools.name: get_market_intel
tools.description: Market intelligence for 32+ DC markets: capacity prices ($/MW-day), vacancy, absorption, dominant operators, growth rate. Try: get_market_intel slug=northern-virginia

tools.name: get_pipeline
tools.description: Construction pipeline: 650+ GW of announced + planned + under-construction data center capacity globally. Filter by company, state, status, ETA. Try: get_pipeline company=AWS state=OH

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: M&A and capacity transactions in the data center industry: buyer, seller, MW, $ size, advisors, close date. Try: list_transactions year=2026

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Latest news from 50+ data center industry sources, deduped + categorized by topic and operator. Try: get_news topic=hyperscale

tools.name: analyze_site
tools.description: Score any lat/lon for data center suitability: power capacity, fiber proximity, gas access, climate risk, market conditions. Try: analyze_site lat=39.04 lon=-77.49

tools.name: compare_sites
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of two coordinates for site selection: infrastructure score, power, fiber, gas, water risk, climate. Try: compare_sites lat1=39.04 lon1=-77.49 lat2=33.07 lon2=-96.81

tools.name: get_energy_prices
tools.description: Industrial electricity rates ($/kWh) by state, with year-over-year deltas. Try: get_energy_prices state=VA

tools.name: get_grid_data
tools.description: Real-time grid demand + 24h load curve for any US ISO. Try: get_grid_data iso=ERCOT

tools.name: get_infrastructure
tools.description: Aggregated infrastructure summary for any metro: substations, fiber, gas, transmission, facilities. Try: get_infrastructure metro=columbus

tools.name: get_fiber_intel
tools.description: Long-haul fiber routes + carrier metro maps. Returns GeoJSON for direct mapping. Try: get_fiber_intel format=geojson

tools.name: get_renewable_energy
tools.description: Renewable generation capacity (solar/wind/hydro) by state, with capacity factor. Try: get_renewable_energy fuel=solar state=TX

tools.name: get_tax_incentives
tools.description: State + local tax incentives for data centers: sales tax exemptions, abatements, special tariffs, eligibility. Try: get_tax_incentives state=OH

tools.name: get_water_risk
tools.description: Water stress index (USGS) by state, county, or coordinate for evaluating cooling sustainability. Try: get_water_risk state=TX
